lens: Skeptic. Fabrics were compared at matched physical scale, using a 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: q15 x0.62 against y_47300, and studio e4 x0.81 against y_47306. Measured: box mean, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, and high-pass column CV. Official photos decide colour; in-flight photos decide geometry (no new downloads). Lighting delta check: current q15 against the ced028f q15 in econ_before_after.jpg, both at x0.43. Seat backs and covers are within dL 0.5 and dB/R 0.02, so lighting round 1 did not change the econ area. The econ source is unchanged since ced028f (rated wF A 7.2), so the score holds. Scratch files are in /tmp/claude-0/rater14A/ (st.py, q15near.png, p00near.png, fab_cmp.png, seat2.png, studio.png).

issues.title: Tick weave: blotchy grey-white dash clusters with navy voids, not continuous lavender chain-stitch columns on royal
issues.evidence: fab_cmp.png pair 1 (y_47306 mid vs e4 mid, both at ~435 px/m). Close up: render L68 #384369 B/R 1.87, p10/p50 0.67; photo L93 #495c98 B/R 2.07, p10/p50 0.56, p90/p50 2.24 vs 1.82. Row distance (q15 x0.62): colCV 0.050/0.080 vs 0.163/0.191.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_tick: remove the low-frequency density/block mask so every column is filled. Put strokes on a fixed column pitch of ~4.5 mm, alternating chevron slant per column, with a 1.2 mm dark channel between columns (the channel carries colCV at distance). Stroke colour toward lavender (#8a9ad4 relative), ground toward royal (#2c3c84 relative; raise ground L ~25 %). In 09_seats.js yFabric (shared, one line): c toward '#4a5c98'. Targets: q15 x0.62 colCV >= 0.12, p10/p50 <= 0.50; e4 close-up p90/p50 ~2.1.

issues.title: Dash mosaic is isotropic speckle; the photo shows horizontal whitish dash rows in density blocks
issues.evidence: fab_cmp.png pair 2. Close up: p90/p50 1.42 vs 2.19, p10/p50 0.65 vs 0.45. q15 seat 2 x0.62: p90/p50 1.24, p10/p50 0.75 (milky).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic: horizontal dashes with aspect 5-10:1 (length 4-14 mm, height ~1 mm) laid in rows at 2.2 mm pitch. Block density 0.35-0.7 as density only, with no outlines. Ground darker navy (x0.75); dashes near-white lavender (lift ~+40 %). Target close-up p90/p50 >= 2.0, p10/p50 <= 0.5.

issues.title: White hood rim across every back top in front views (open since w12)
issues.evidence: q15near.png vs p00near.png: a ~1.5 cm white band over the top of rows 1-2 backs; the photo shows a fabric crown.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: wrap the back's top fabric section 1.5 cm up and 1 cm aft over the shell lip, or drop the shell's front lip 1.5 cm down and 1 cm aft so it hides behind the fabric crown head-on.

issues.title: Headrest cover is a flat saturated navy; the photo leatherette is slate grey, dark head-on and silver-grey at grazing angles
issues.evidence: Head-on q15: L55-65 B/R 1.88-1.98, cover/back 0.74-0.89, against y_47300 L35-46 B/R 1.83-2.0, cover/back 0.54-0.77. y_47306 (lit, oblique): B/R 1.47-1.62, L83-123. y_47301 / y_47303: covers read light grey-silver from the side and above. q16/q17: covers stay navy at every angle.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yCover (shared, one line): c '#2a2f45' (B/R ~1.6, ~15 % darker), roughness ~0.40 with higher specular/Fresnel, so oblique views pick up the grey ceiling. Optional 3 mm lighter stitched border inset.

issues.title: Diamond: ragged dark-edged blotches, figures too dark
issues.evidence: fab_cmp.png pair 3: y_47306 left p50 100, p90 219, p90/p50 2.19; e4 left p50 56, p90/p50 1.81. The photo figures are large crisp pale-periwinkle stars and diamonds in chains on mid blue.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond: remove the blur, use a star metric (|du|^0.75 + |dv|^0.75 <= 1), give figures ~35 mm across in diagonal chains, raise the figure fill to pale periwinkle (lift ~3.0) and keep the ground mid royal. Target p90/p50 ~2.1.

issues.title: Fleck snowy and white close up (pads, q16 near seats)
issues.evidence: e4 pad: p90/p50 1.99 vs y_47306 pad 1.62. q16 near pads and backs show near-white flecks; the photo's are light blue.
issues.fix: Tint the fleck toward light blue (#a4b4e4 relative) and cut the lift ~15 %, keeping fleck size (distance stats now match: 1.75 vs 1.89).

issues.title: Hero-row fabric mix differs from y_47300
issues.evidence: q15 front row: tick / mosaic back with diamond pads / tick / fleck. y_47300: tick / fleck / tick / fleck.
issues.fix: 05_layout.js or 09_seats.js fabric assignment: alternate tick and fleck across a 3-3 or 4-block so the q15 hero row reproduces the photo.

issues.title: Pillow has no pinched corner ears or edge seam
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow: corner pull X *= 1 + 0.12*(sx*sz)^2 with the corners tapered to 30 % thickness, plus a 4 mm darker perimeter seam.

issues.title: Screen lower bezel lacks LED / sensor dots
issues.evidence: y_47305 shows 4-5 tiny dots on the lower bezel; q18 shows none. Bezel height now matches (5.6 % vs 5.9 %).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: 4 dim 3 mm dots centred on the lower bezel.

issues.title: QA cameras do not match their reference photos
issues.evidence: q15 is ~0.3 m high and close, with no armrests or pillows in frame. q16 and q17 do not reproduce y_47301 / y_47303.
issues.fix: test/qa.js: lower the q15 camera ~0.3 m and move it ~1 row aft; re-aim q16/q17 to the photo viewpoints. Not scored.

issues.title: Lighting round 1 left the econ seats unchanged
issues.evidence: Current q15 vs the ced028f q15 at x0.43: backs dL <= 0.2, covers dL 0.1. No regression, and no gain toward the photo's brighter close-up fabric (y_47306 lit tick L93 vs studio L68; studio lighting, not cabin).
